description: Insert links as [Title](url) instead of the plain address

title: Degrees
name: tooldetail_calc_degrees_title
description: Trigonometry functions use degrees. Off uses radians

title: Phone layout
name: tooldetail_calc_phone_layout_title
description: 1 2 3 on the top row, like a dialer and the numpad. Off puts 7 8 9 on top, like a desk calculator

title: Result precision
name: tooldetail_calc_precision_title
description: Maximum number of decimal places. The unit converter uses it too

title: Feet and inches
name: tooldetail_units_compound_title
description: Show a length in feet as feet and inches, not as a decimal
help: 1 metre reads as "3 ft 3.37 in" instead of "3.2808399 ft". The chip writes the units the way that you did: "1m" answers with "3 ft 3.37 in" and "1 meter" answers with "3 feet 3.37 inches". Where there is no room for either, it falls back to "3'3"". Turn this off for the plain decimal.

title: Fetch rates as you type
name: tooldetail_currency_auto_fetch_title
description: Off, a currency chip waits for your tap before it goes online
help: This setting controls only the chip on the suggestion strip. The panel fetches rates when you open it, and rates that the keyboard already has convert with no fetch. The F-Droid edition starts with this setting off.

title: Decimal places
name: tooldetail_currency_decimals_title
description: Rounding of the converted amount. Coins have their own setting

title: Write the result as
name: tooldetail_currency_label_title
description: How a currency chip names the currency that it converted into
help: Name writes "96.04 Rupee", Symbol writes "₹96.04" and Code writes "96.04 INR". A currency with no symbol of its own falls back to its code. Coins keep their ticker, such as BTC, with every choice.

title: Refresh the rates every
name: tooldetail_currency_refresh_title
description: How long a fetched exchange rate stays fresh
help: The upstream rates update about one time each day. A value below 24 hours mostly changes how soon the keyboard tries a failed fetch again.

title: Currency rates from
name: tooldetail_currency_source_title
description: Where the fiat exchange rates are fetched

title: Convert coins
name: tooldetail_crypto_enable_title
description: Read amounts like "1 btc" and show coins in the converter
help: "1 btc", "0.5 ETH", "2 bitcoin" and "100000 sats" put the amount in your currency on the suggestion strip. Tickers that are also ordinary words, such as DOT, LINK and NEAR, only count when you type them in capitals. Coin prices are fetched only when you type a coin amount or select a coin on the panel.

title: Coin decimal places
name: tooldetail_crypto_decimals_title
description: Automatic keeps five meaningful digits, which fits both a whole coin and a fraction of one

title: Refresh coin prices every
name: tooldetail_crypto_refresh_title
description: Coin prices move much faster than the daily currency table

title: Coin prices from
name: tooldetail_crypto_source_title
description: Where the coin prices are fetched

title: Coins
name: tooldetail_crypto_coins_title
description: %1$d on. Select the coins that the keyboard reads and offers

title: Image size
name: tooldetail_qr_gen_size_title
description: Side length of the PNG that the keyboard inserts

title: Send as
name: tooldetail_qr_gen_send_title
description: QR codes go out as images by default
help: Some chat apps draw a plain incoming image with no bubble. That can look like a sticker, even though it was sent as an image. Sticker mode offers the WhatsApp sticker type instead, where the app supports it.

title: Save to the gallery
name: tooldetail_qr_gen_gallery_title
description: Also keep generated codes in Pictures/WM Keyboard

title: Capital letters
name: tooldetail_password_uppercase_title
description: A to Z

title: Digits
name: tooldetail_password_digits_title
description: 0 to 9

title: Exclude look-alikes
name: tooldetail_password_ambiguous_title
description: Skip Il1O0o5S8B and similar characters

title: Separator
name: tooldetail_passphrase_separator_label
description: Between words, for example - or . Leave it blank for none

title: Capitalize the words
name: tooldetail_passphrase_capitalize_title
description: correct-Horse → Correct-Horse

title: Include a digit
name: tooldetail_passphrase_digit_title
description: The keyboard adds it to a random word

title: Times
name: tooldetail_repeat_count_title
description: How many copies the panel opens on

title: Mode
name: tooldetail_repeat_mode_title
description: Copies in a row, the last letter stretched, or a staircase

title: Between the copies
name: tooldetail_repeat_separator_title
description: Nothing, a space, a new line, a comma, or your own

title: Custom separator
name: tooldetail_repeat_custom_label
description: Up to 8 characters, for example " | "

title: Number each copy
name: tooldetail_repeat_numbered_title
description: 1. ha  2. ha  3. ha

title: Alternate the case
name: tooldetail_repeat_alternate_title
description: ha HA ha HA

title: Longest result
name: tooldetail_repeat_max_chars_title
description: The panel stops at the last whole copy that fits and says so

title: When opened from the chip
name: tooldetail_repeat_chip_insert_title
description: What Insert does with the copies you had already typed

title: Chip after this many repeats
name: tooldetail_repeat_chip_after_title
description: Type the same thing this many times in a row and the strip offers the tool

title: Remember recent texts
name: tooldetail_repeat_recents_title
description: The panel offers the last ten texts you repeated
help: Kept on this phone only, and never in a backup. Nothing is remembered in incognito mode, in password fields, or in fields that ask not to be learnt from.

title: Edit the keyboard modes
name: tooldetail_modes_edit_title
description: Setups for each app and each field, and what each one changes

title: Punctuation
name: toolai_typing_punctuation_title
description: Capital letters, commas and full stops in the test text

title: Numbers
name: toolai_typing_numbers_title
description: The keyboard mixes numbers into the test words

title: Glide typing
name: toolai_typing_glide_title
description: Swipe words during a test, to see how much faster gestures make you

title: Suggestions
name: toolai_typing_suggestions_title
description: Show the suggestion strip during a test, in its usual row above the keys. Tapping a word finishes it

title: Clear records
name: toolai_typing_clear_records_title
description: Deletes every best score, the run history and the badges

title: Seconds per direction
name: tooldetail_speed_duration_title
description: How long the download and the upload each run. Longer is steadier and costs more data.

title: Connections at once
name: tooldetail_speed_connections_title
description: Requests in flight together. One connection rarely fills a fast line; four is what the browser tests use.

title: Measure upload
name: tooldetail_speed_upload_title
description: Off, a run is pings and download only, and takes half the time and data.

title: Send a sticker-sized card as
name: tooldetail_speed_send_mode_title
description: Only the Sticker size can go as a sticker, and only into apps that take one. The other sizes are always pictures.

title: Save sent cards to the gallery
name: tooldetail_speed_save_gallery_title
description: A copy of every card you send goes into Pictures/WM Keyboard. The panel's Save button saves one whether this is on or not.

title: Show my IP address
name: tooldetail_speed_show_ip_title
description: Put the connection's public address in the card's footer. Off, the card names only the network and the server.

title: AI providers
name: toolai_ai_providers_title
description: A service, your own server, or files on the phone
help: The services and models the AI tools, AI reply, the chat and the settings assistant can use. Add a service with its key, a server you run, or a model on your device. You can add the same service more than once, for a second key or a second server. One of them answers at a time: pick it under In use, or with the model picker on the AI panel.

title: In use
name: toolai_ai_in_use_title
description: The provider the AI tools ask. The model picker on the AI panel changes it too

title: Maximum response length
name: toolai_ai_max_tokens_title
description: The limit in tokens. One token is about three quarters of a word. A reasoning model gets four times this limit, because its reasoning uses the same budget. Select the provider maximum for long text.

title: Target language for the Translate action
name: toolai_ai_translate_to_label
description: For example English, Bengali, Japanese

title: Show model reasoning
name: toolai_ai_show_thinking_title
description: The panel shows the <think> text of reasoning models instead of a progress bar

title: Model picker on the panel
name: toolai_ai_model_picker_title
description: Change between the providers that you set up and the models that you download, on the keyboard

title: Actions on the panel
name: toolai_ai_actions_title
description: Add your own actions, change the prompts, and turn off the ones that you do not use

title: Show a changes view
name: toolai_ai_diff_title
description: The panel gets a Changes button that marks what the model added and what it deleted

title: Open a result on the changes
name: toolai_ai_diff_first_title
description: The panel starts on the changes instead of the plain result

title: AI suggestions
name: toolai_strip_suggest_title
description: The app never asks in a password field, in a field that turns off suggestions, or in incognito. Each pause after a word is one request, and a new key press cancels it. Tap the suggestion to insert it. Hold it to hide AI suggestions until you go to a different field.
help: The app never asks in a password field, in a field that turns off suggestions, or in incognito. Each pause after a word is one request, and a new key press cancels it. Tap the suggestion to insert it. Hold it to hide AI suggestions until you go to a different field.

title: Send only the last word
name: toolai_strip_suggest_word_only_title
description: Sends less of your text. The suggestions are less accurate.

title: Text to send
name: toolai_strip_suggest_chars_title
description: How many characters before the cursor each request sends

title: Let the model search the web
name: toolai_ai_tool_search_title
description: It writes its own search and reads the results. Searches go to whichever service the search tool uses, and count against that service's quota.

title: Let the model read a web page
name: toolai_ai_tool_fetch_title
description: It opens one address and reads the text on it. Needs no search service.
help: This is the one tool that will open an address it found in your own text, so it is off until you ask for it. The page is read as plain text and cut short; no scripts run, and nothing is sent to the page.

title: Keyboard tools
name: toolai_ai_builtin_title
description: Let the model use the keyboard's own tools, such as the weather, the calculator and the translator
help: Run lets the model use a tool whenever it needs to. Ask shows you each request first, with what it will send, and you allow it or not. Off keeps the tool out of the model's reach. Each tool that is on is described to the model in every request, which costs a little each time, and a small model on your device copes best with only a few.

title: WM Keyboard docs
name: toolai_ai_builtin_wm_docs_title
description: Searches this keyboard's documentation to answer questions about the keyboard itself. Sends only the search words, to the docs site.

title: Image search
name: toolai_ai_builtin_image_search_title
description: Finds pictures through the search tool's service

title: Weather
name: toolai_ai_builtin_weather_title
description: Today's and tomorrow's weather for any place, or for the place saved in the weather tool

title: Wikipedia
name: toolai_ai_builtin_wikipedia_title
description: Reads the summary of an article, in the Wikipedia language that the encyclopedia tool uses

title: Dictionary
name: toolai_ai_builtin_define_word_title
description: Looks a word up in the dictionary tool's sources

title: Translate
name: toolai_ai_builtin_translate_title
description: Translates with the translate tool's engine, on your device or online as you set it there

title: Currency converter
name: toolai_ai_builtin_convert_currency_title
description: Converts money at live exchange rates from the currency tool's sources

title: Unit converter
name: toolai_ai_builtin_convert_units_title

title: Calculator

title: Keep older backups spread out
name: backup_auto_staggered_title

help: Backups to keep counts the newest backups. With this on, the app also spares some older ones instead of deleting them: the newest backup of each of the last 7 days, of each of the last 5 weeks, and of each of the last 12 months. That is at most 24 more files, and fewer when one backup stands for several of them. A setting you changed by mistake a month ago can then still be taken back, without keeping a month of daily backups to do it. The ages count back from your newest backup, so a phone that stops backing up for a while keeps its old copies until new ones replace them. This setting is off by default.

title: Learn from typing
name: privacy_learn_typing_title
description: The keyboard adjusts the suggestions to your typing. Nothing leaves your device
help: The keyboard keeps the words and the word pairs that you type in a private word list on this device. This makes the suggestions and glide typing better. The keyboard learns nothing in a password field, and nothing while incognito mode is on. You can delete the learned words below at any time.

title: Add words to the system dictionary
name: privacy_system_dictionary_title
description: Share the learned words with the Android personal dictionary
help: The keyboard also saves the words that you type in the Android personal dictionary. Other keyboards and the spell checker of the system then know these words too. It is the same list that you can edit in System settings → Languages & input → Dictionary. This setting is off at the start: the keyboard has its own learning, and this setting writes outside the app. It obeys "Learn from typing" and incognito mode. When you turn it off, the words that are already in the list stay there.

title: Expand Android dictionary shortcuts
name: privacy_dict_shortcuts_title
description: Type a shortcut from the Android personal dictionary to get its full phrase as a suggestion
help: Each entry in the Android personal dictionary can have a shortcut. It is the same list in System settings → Languages & input → Dictionary. With this setting on, you type a shortcut, for example "omw", and its full phrase, "on my way", becomes the top suggestion. This setting is on at the start. The keyboard reads the list again each time you change it, so a shortcut that you add in System settings works at once. This setting is not the snippets of the keyboard. A snippet belongs to the Snippets tool, has its own screen under Features → Text Expander, and works whether this setting is on or off.

title: Incognito mode
name: privacy_incognito_title
description: Pause learning and clipboard capture
help: While this setting is on, the keyboard learns nothing from your typing and keeps no clipboard history. The words that it learned before stay as they are.

title: Follow private browsing
name: privacy_auto_incognito_title
description: Turn incognito mode on by itself in private tabs and fields
help: An app can mark a text field as a field that the keyboard must not learn from. Chrome does this for every field in an incognito tab. Other browsers and password managers do the same on their private screens. While such a field has the focus, the keyboard turns incognito mode on for it, and the incognito badge shows next to the toolbar. When you leave the field, typing goes back to normal. The keyboard cannot detect an app that never sends this mark. This setting does not work for a private mode of that kind.

title: Incognito by app
name: privacy_incognito_apps_title
description: Add an app
help: Follow private browsing goes by what each text field asks for. Add an app here to decide for it instead: every field in an app set to always incognito is incognito, and no field in an app set to never is, whatever it asks. Tap an app to switch between the two.

title: Back up with Android
name: privacy_backup_title
description: Include the keyboard in the Android backup and in the device-to-device transfer
help: This setting is off at the start. The keyboard copies nothing that it stores to Google Drive or to a new device. Turn it on, and the Android backup treats the keyboard like any other app. Your settings, themes, layouts, snippets, learned words, sticker packs, icon packs and plugins come back on a new device, or after you install the app again. The backup leaves out the voice models, the AI models, the downloaded word lists and the emoji keyword packs. The keyboard can download these again by itself, and the backup must stay inside the size limit of Android. The backup does include your saved API keys. Android makes a cloud backup only on a device that can encrypt it with your screen lock. Backup & restore in Settings is the other way, and it never uses Google. It saves the same data in a file that you move yourself.

title: Verify downloaded files
name: privacy_verify_checksums_title
description: Check every download and import against its published checksum
help: Each file that the keyboard downloads or imports has a published SHA-256 checksum: dictionary packs, voice models, fonts, add-ons, themes, Keyman layouts and app updates. The keyboard refuses a file whose checksum does not match, because the file is damaged or is not the file that was published. Keep this setting on. Turn it off only for a short time, when the developer tells you that a file changed on the server and your version of the app still expects the old file. Updates still need the developer's signature to install.

help: When this is on, other apps on the phone can send the keyboard commands, for example to change the language or the theme. The Allowed actions screen sets which commands work. When this is off, the keyboard ignores all commands.

title: Use the app lock
name: privacy_lock_enabled_title
description: Turning this on and off also asks for a check
help:
The keyboard asks for your fingerprint, or the PIN, password or pattern set on this screen, before it opens the screens that you tick below, and before it runs the delete buttons that you tick. It asks again before you can turn this setting off, so somebody holding your unlocked phone cannot simply switch it off.

This is a lock on the screens, not encryption. It does not change how anything is stored. A settings export, the Android backup, a computer with USB debugging on, and a rooted phone all still reach the same data, and the keyboard itself keeps working as before. What the lock stops is the case it is for: somebody who picks up your unlocked phone for half a minute.

If the lock uses your fingerprint and you remove every fingerprint and the screen lock from this phone, the lock stands aside and the screens open normally. There is then nothing to check against, and you must never be shut out of your own settings. A PIN, password or pattern set here never stands aside. If you forget it, Forgot? on its sheet lets this phone's own fingerprint or screen lock in instead.

title: Ask again
name: privacy_lock_relock_title
description: One check opens every locked screen until this time is up. A delete button always asks again, however recently you answered, because that check is the last step before something goes away for good.
help: One check opens every locked screen until this time is up. A delete button always asks again, however recently you answered, because that check is the last step before something goes away for good.

title: Allow the screen lock instead
name: privacy_lock_credential_title
description: Accept the PIN, pattern or password of this phone as well as a fingerprint
help: Keep this on unless you have a reason not to. It is the way back in when the fingerprint reader locks itself out after too many tries, and it is the only way this works at all on a phone with no reader. Turn it off and a fingerprint is the only answer the lock accepts.

title: Answer the lock with
name: privacy_lock_method_title
description:
Fingerprint uses this phone's own prompt, and its screen lock too if you allow it below. A PIN, password or pattern is set here, for this app only, and works on a phone with no fingerprint reader and no screen lock.

Only a scrambled copy of the PIN, password or pattern is kept, never the thing itself. It is left out of every backup unless you include passwords and keys, so on a new phone the lock asks for the fingerprint until you set one again. Five wrong answers in a row make the next one wait, from 30 seconds up to 15 minutes. A short PIN is still a short PIN: six digits or more is worth the extra second.

title: Offer the fingerprint first
name: privacy_lock_shortcut_title

title: Save data now
name: datasaver_manual_title
description: Keep data saving on, whatever the connection is
help: Stays on until you turn it off, on Wi-Fi too. Use this when the network is not really free, such as a phone hotspot that Android counts as unmetered.

title: Turn on by itself
name: datasaver_trigger_title
description: What arms data saving without you
help: Metered covers mobile data and any Wi-Fi network you or your carrier marked as metered. Roaming is the strictest: it saves data only while you are on another network abroad.

title: Link previews
name: datasaver_link_previews_title
description: Titles and thumbnails for copied links and scanned QR codes

title: Word look-ups
name: datasaver_dictionary_title
description: The definition fetched when you select a word

title: Photo backgrounds
name: datasaver_photos_title
description: Refilling the pool of rotating background photos

title: Weather chip
name: datasaver_weather_title
description: The forecast behind the weather suggestion

title: Exchange rates
name: datasaver_rates_title
description: Rate tables for the currency chip and converter. A few hundred bytes.

title: Add-on updates
name: datasaver_addons_title
description: Re-reading add-on repositories to find new versions

title: GIFs and stickers
name: datasaver_media_title
description: Searching and loading the GIF and sticker grids. Your own packs always work.

title: Web and image search
name: datasaver_search_title
description: Search results and the thumbnails an image grid loads

title: Animated emoji
name: datasaver_animated_emoji_title
description: Fetching the animated version of an emoji to send

title: Downloads
name: datasaver_downloads_title
description: Language data, dictionaries, add-ons and the on-device models

title: Cloud AI
name: datasaver_ai_title
description: Chat and AI actions that run on a provider's servers. On-device models are never held.

title: Transcription server
name: datasaver_voice_title
description: Voice typing that sends each phrase to your transcription server. About a megabyte for every 30 seconds of speech.

title: Online grammar check
name: datasaver_grammar_title
description: Grammar check that sends the text to a LanguageTool server, a few kilobytes after each pause in typing. Turned off, English is checked on the phone and other languages wait.

title: Use on-device models offline
name: datasaver_offline_fallback_title
description: Voice typing, AI actions and Translate use a downloaded model when your server cannot be reached
help: Voice typing with a transcription server, AI actions with a cloud or server provider, and Translate with the Online engine all need a connection. With this setting on, each one uses the on-device model you downloaded when the phone has no connection, or when the server does not answer. Voice typing uses a Whisper model for your language, or else the voice typing of your phone. AI actions use your on-device AI model. Translate uses the on-device languages you downloaded. A short message tells you when the keyboard changes to the on-device model. Translate also shows "On device, offline" next to the result. Nothing changes for a feature that has no model downloaded, and nothing changes while the connection works.

title: Downloads
name: notify_downloads_title
description: Progress for dictionaries, voice models and add-ons, and a line when one finishes or fails

title: App updates
name: notify_updates_title
description: An update downloading, one waiting to be installed, and one just installed

title: Backup problems
name: notify_backup_title
description: Only when an automatic backup does not go through. A backup that works says nothing.

title: Keyboard controls
name: notify_controls_title
description: A permanent entry in the shade for bringing the keyboard back
help: Useful with Keep on screen: once the keyboard has gone down over a window with no text field in it, there is nothing left to tap to bring it back. This puts Show, Unpin and Switch keyboard in the shade instead. It stays there until you turn it off.

title: Where it appears
name: selection_macros_placement_title
description: The row the actions are drawn on

title: Show on every selection
name: selection_macros_every_title
description: Keep Select all, Copy, Cut, Paste and Delete on very long selections
help:
The keyboard does not read a selection longer than 4000 characters: reading one that size costs real time, and every action that works on the text needs it read first.

So a selection that long normally takes the whole bar away, Copy and Paste included, even though those two never needed the text — the app does that work itself.

On, the bar stays up past that length with Select all, Copy, Cut, Paste and Delete, whichever of them you have switched on. Everything else still waits for a shorter selection: the case options, the rewrites, and the actions for a phone number, an address or a link.

It also covers the few apps whose text boxes will not hand a selection over at all, where the same five actions are the only ones that can work.

Password fields never show the bar, whichever way this is set.

title: Show with nothing selected
name: selection_macros_caret_title
description: Keep the row up at the caret, with Select all and Paste
help:
Normally the row only appears while text is selected. On, it stays above the keys all the time, so the actions are there before you select anything.

With nothing selected it holds Select all and Paste, whichever of them you have switched on. Tap Select all and the full row for the whole text takes its place: Copy, Translate and the rest.

Only for the row of its own. Over the suggestion strip it would take the suggestions away while you type, so this switch is hidden there.

Password fields never show the row, whichever way this is set.

title: Read what is selected
name: selection_macros_detect_title
description: Offer Call for a phone number, Open for a link, Email for an address
help:
The keyboard reads the selection as a whole. A sentence with a phone number in it is text, not a number: you selected the sentence.

Switch this off and every selection is read as plain text. You keep Select all, Copy, Share and the case options, and lose the actions that are about a phone number, an address or a link.

Phone numbers use the same formats as the clipboard, under Privacy > Clipboard.

title: WM Keyboard in the selection menu
name: text_actions_settings_actions_title
description: Translate, AI and these actions on text selected in any app
help:
Opens a sheet over the app with the text you selected. Translate it, run an AI action on it, or rewrite it with the actions from the list below (case, lines, the converters), one after another. Undo steps back.

When the text is in a box you can edit, Replace puts the result in place of your selection. When it is not, such as a web page, Copy takes it instead.

This works whether the keyboard's own bar is on or off.

title: WM Translate in the selection menu
name: text_actions_settings_translate_title
description: An entry that opens straight on the translation. Needs the Translate tool

title: Microphone
name: privacy_permissions_mic_title
description: Dictate text with the voice input tool

title: Camera
name: privacy_permissions_camera_title
description: Take a photo with the camera tool and send it into the chat

title: Contacts
name: privacy_permissions_contacts_title
description: Suggest the names and the email addresses of your contacts while you type

title: Calendar
name: privacy_permissions_calendar_title
description: The calendar tool lists the events of your day

title: Change calendar events
name: privacy_permissions_calendar_write_title
description: The calendar tool saves, changes and deletes the events you edit, and the AI adds events when you set it to

title: Photos and images
name: privacy_permissions_images_title
description: Show your new screenshots in the clipboard

title: Notification access
name: privacy_permissions_notifications_title
description: Media controls on the keyboard, and one-time codes from your notifications

title: Usage access
name: privacy_permissions_usage_title
description: Show which app a clipboard entry was copied from

title: Display over other apps
name: privacy_permissions_overlay_title
description: The floating buttons that open the keyboard and the AI chat

title: Accessibility service
name: privacy_permissions_accessibility_title
description: Keep the keyboard gestures while TalkBack is on

title: Accessibility service for the AI button
name: privacy_permissions_screen_content_title
description: Let the floating AI button read the screen when you press it

title: Accessibility service for split screen
name: privacy_permissions_split_screen_title
description: Let the app launcher press Android's split screen switch

title: Install updates
name: privacy_permissions_install_updates_title
description: Install a new version of this app that you downloaded from its release page

title: Internet
name: privacy_permissions_internet_title
description: Only the network tools use it: translate, weather, search, GIFs, stickers, dictionary and the AI tools

title: Vibration
name: privacy_permissions_vibrate_title
description: Haptic feedback when you press a key

title: Fingerprint
name: privacy_permissions_biometric_title
description: Ask the system to check a fingerprint for the lock in Privacy. The app never sees the fingerprint itself

title: Symbol row
name: rows_symbol_row_title
description: A row of special characters and snippets above the keys
help: The row shows one symbol set at a time. It can be @gmail.com and similar for email, https:// for the web, or brackets for coding. The chip at the left edge of the row changes the set. A keyboard mode can select a set for each app automatically.

title: Symbol row height
name: rows_symbol_row_height_title
description: How tall the symbol row is
help: The number row has its own height setting under Layout & size. This is the same setting for the symbol row, so you can make the two rows match, or make this one shorter to give the keys below more room.

title: Lines of symbols
name: rows_symbol_row_lines_title
description: How many lines the symbol row stacks
help: Each line is one symbol row height tall and shows the next entries of the set, so more of a set is on screen without a scroll. The row keeps its picker at the left edge whatever the count.

title: Scrolling
name: rows_symbol_row_scroll_title
description: How the lines move when you scroll sideways

title: Fancy text
name: rows_fancy_title
description: Type in 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝘪𝘵𝘢𝘭𝘪𝘤, 𝔉𝔯𝔞𝔨𝔱𝔲𝔯 and other Unicode styles, picked from a row above the keys
help: This switches the keyboard to the Fancy text layout and back, the same as the Fancy text tool on the toolbar. While it is on, a row of styles sits above the keys; the Normal style at its start types plain letters again. Turning it off returns to the language you were typing in and takes Fancy text out of the language list, unless the tool's "Keep the language after you turn it off" option is on.

title: Dictionary bar
name: rows_dictionary_bar_title
description: A row of chips above the keys that turns each dictionary on or off
help: The bar lists every dictionary on the device: each language's word list, its emoji keywords, and every word list that you imported. A coloured chip is on; tap it to turn that dictionary off, and tap again to turn it back on. The chip at the left edge of the bar filters the row to one language, or shows all of them. The same switches live on each language's own settings screen.

title: Where the recent words go
name: rows_recent_words_placement_title
description: A row of their own sits in the row order above, over the suggestion strip unless you move it, and keeps the strip's full width for the suggestions. At the start of the strip, the recent words take its left end and the suggestions follow them, so the keyboard never grows for them.
help: A row of their own sits in the row order above, over the suggestion strip unless you move it, and keeps the strip's full width for the suggestions. At the start of the strip, the recent words take its left end and the suggestions follow them, so the keyboard never grows for them.

title: Keep the row's height
name: rows_recent_words_steady_title
description: The row stays while it is empty, so the keyboard doesn't change height between messages
help: Without this, the row is there only while it has words to show, so the keyboard grows by it after your first word and shrinks again when a chat app empties the box on send. With it on, the row keeps its place empty instead.

title: Use modes
name: modes_enabled_title
description: Let apps and field types switch the keyboard setup
help: Modes are off by default. When they are on, the keyboard changes its emoji row, its pinned tools and its symbol sets to match the app or the field you are typing in. Turn this off to use one setup everywhere. Your modes are kept, so turning it back on restores all of them.

title: Drags edit the active mode
name: modes_drag_edits_title
description: The keyboard saves a drag into the mode that is on
help: A mode that has its own pinned tools or toolbox order wins over the global lists while the mode is active. With this setting on, the keyboard writes the new tool order back into that mode. The change stays where you made it, and the apps on a different mode keep their own arrangement. With this setting off, a drag always changes the global order, and the list of the mode continues to override it.

title: Use this mode
name: modes_use_title
description: Off, the mode never turns on and the Modes tool does not show it
help: Turn this off to stop a mode without deleting it. Its apps, field types, hints and overrides are kept, and the mode comes back as it was when you turn it on again.

title: Name
name: modes_name_label
description: The Modes tool shows this name

title: Icon
name: modes_icon_title
description: The Modes tool shows this icon beside the name

title: Emoji row
name: modes_emoji_row_title
description: While this mode is active

title: Autocorrect
name: modes_autocorrect_title
description: While this mode is active

title: Layout
name: modes_layout_title
description: Which layout this mode types on
help: The mode wears this layout while it is on, whichever layout you were using before. Your own layout comes back when the mode ends, and the spacebar swipe order is not changed. Only layouts you have switched on are offered here; if you later switch one off, a mode that used it goes back to inheriting.

title: Theme
name: modes_theme_title
description: Inherit the theme that is set

title: Custom pinned tools
name: modes_pinned_tools_title
description: Change the pinned tools of the toolbar while this mode is active

title: Pinned tools behaviour
name: modes_pinned_behaviour_title
description: The keyboard adds these tools after the tools you pinned yourself

title: Custom toolbox order
name: modes_toolbox_order_title
description: Move the tools of this mode to the front of the toolbox panel

title: Custom symbol sets
name: modes_symbol_sets_title
description: The symbol row shows only the sets of this mode while it is active

title: Automatic spaces
name: modes_autospace_title
description: Spaces the keyboard types for you while this mode is active
help: One switch over every space the keyboard puts in without a press: after punctuation, after a suggestion you pick from the strip, and after a word you glide. Off means every space in the field is one you typed, which is what you want when you are renaming a file extension, typing a command, or filling any field where a stray space is a mistake. On turns all three on, including the space after punctuation, which is off by default everywhere else.

title: Glide typing
name: modes_glide_title
help: Off makes every tap type exactly its key: a tap that drifts across the keys can no longer start a swipe. With autocorrect, suggestions and automatic spaces off too, this is a peck mode for codes, handles, slang and anything else the keyboard would try to fix.

title: Two-thumb typing
name: modes_two_thumb_title
help: Off types each swipe as a word of its own, and a pause no longer ends a tapped word with a space you did not press. A word you are in the middle of is typed as it stands when the mode turns this off.

title: Add app
name: modes_add_app_title
description: This mode turns on when you select a field in the app

title: Colour vision
name: accessibility_color_vision_title
description: Change the keyboard colours for colour blindness
help:
This setting changes the keyboard colours. Colours that look the same to you become different.

Select the type that agrees with your vision. Deuteranopia and protanopia are the two red-green types. Deuteranopia is the most common one. Tritanopia is the blue-yellow type. Grey removes all colour.

This setting corrects the colours. It does not simulate them. It does not show you what a person with colour blindness sees. It makes the keyboard easier for you to read.

title: High contrast keys
name: accessibility_high_contrast_title
description: Labels with the highest contrast on a plain black or white board
help:
The keyboard replaces the key colours and the board colours of the theme with flat high contrast colours. Every label becomes pure black or pure white.

The keyboard keeps the accent colour of your theme. Shift and the active tools stay easy to see.

This setting replaces the colours of the selected theme while it is on.

If the key shape of the theme is None, the keys become rounded while this setting is on.

title: Key outlines
name: accessibility_key_outlines_title
description: Draw a border around every key and every toolbar tool
help:
Outlines keep the key edges easy to see when the key colour and the board colour have almost the same brightness. This helps with themes that are partly transparent, or with a background image.

The background behind each toolbar tool gets the same border, unless that background is switched off in Appearance.

A theme that has its own key border or tool outline keeps it.

If the key shape of the theme is None, the keys become rounded while this setting is on.

title: Bold key labels
name: accessibility_bold_labels_title
description: Heavier letters on the keys
help: The keyboard makes the lines of the key labels thicker. Use this with high contrast keys on a small screen, or on a screen with low brightness.

title: Readable font
name: accessibility_readable_font_title
description: Use %1$s on the keyboard
help:
The Braille Institute made %1$s for people with low vision or with reading difficulty. Characters that usually look the same are drawn differently. Examples are the capital I, the lowercase l and the digit 1, or the capital O and the zero.

This setting is a shortcut for the keyboard font. When you turn it off, the keyboard uses the system font again. To select another font, go to Appearance › Keyboard font.

title: Text size
name: accessibility_text_size_title
description: Size of the labels on the keys

title: Keyboard font
name: accessibility_keyboard_font_title
description: See all the fonts, or import your own font

title: Reduce motion
name: accessibility_reduce_motion_title
description: Turn off the animation that is not necessary
help:
This setting is for motion sensitivity. It turns off the slide and scale transitions in the keyboard toolbar and in this settings app. It also turns off the animated theme backgrounds, the blinking cursors and the pulse ring of the microphone.

The keyboard keeps the feedback that gives you information: the key preview bubble, the colour of a pressed key and the gesture trail. Without this feedback the keyboard is more difficult to use.

The cursors and the microphone ring stay visible. They hold still.

When you turn animations off for the whole device, in Accessibility or in the developer options, the keyboard follows that and behaves as if this setting is on. This setting stays yours: it turns motion off for the keyboard only, and it leaves the rest of your device as it is.

title: Classic press-and-hold popup
name: accessibility_classic_popup_title
description: The alternates popup as it used to be, with nothing moving under your finger
help:
When you hold a key, its alternates popup normally opens with the first alternate right over the key and the others on both sides of it, the alternate you aim at grows, and the highlight follows your finger a row above it and slides from one alternate to the next.

Turn this on for the popup as it used to be. It opens where the key is, the alternates run in reading order, the highlight is on whatever alternate is under your finger, nothing grows, and the highlight jumps straight to the next alternate instead of sliding. Choosing still works the same way: slide to an alternate and lift.

title: Animate panels
name: accessibility_panel_motion_title
description: Panels grow out of the button or tool name that opened them
help:
When you open a panel such as the clipboard, emoji or a tool, it grows out of the toolbar button or the tool name you tapped, and it folds back into it when you close it. The animation is short, so it does not slow you down.

Turn this off and panels appear and disappear at once. Reduce motion also turns this off.

title: Animate text selection
name: accessibility_selection_motion_title
description: The selection highlight and its buttons move smoothly
help:
While you select text with the keyboard, the highlight slides to the new selection and the buttons of the selection bar come in one after the other.

Turn this off and the selection and its buttons change at once. Reduce motion also turns this off.

title: Animate language switch
name: accessibility_language_switch_motion_title
description: Keys flip to the new language when you switch
help:
When you switch language, each key that shows a different letter in the new language flips over to it. Keys that stay the same hold still, so you can see what changed.

Off by default, because the plain switch is the fastest. Only a language switch animates. Changing to symbols or numbers never does. Reduce motion also turns this off.

title: Animate grammar and translate results
name: accessibility_tool_result_motion_title
description: Fixes and translations move into place
help:
In the grammar tool, a fix you apply crosses out the old words and slides the new ones in, and the list of problems closes up around it. In the translate tool, the part of the translation that changed fades in while the words that stayed hold still, and the language swap button turns.

Off by default, because these tools are for getting text out fast. Reduce motion also turns this off.

title: Icons in settings
name: accessibility_row_icons_title
description: A coloured icon beside every setting and screen name
help:
Turn this off for plain rows that show only words, as in earlier versions of the app. Some people find a list of words easier to read than a column of coloured icons.

This changes only these settings screens. The icons of the keyboard and of its tools stay as they are.

title: Screen transitions
name: accessibility_screen_transitions_title
description: A setting's icon and name move into the screen it opens
help:
Turn this off if these settings screens are slow to open on your phone. Moving a setting's icon and name into the screen it opens makes each screen take more work to draw, and some slower phones show that as a stutter. With this off, a screen opens with the plain slide, and it draws faster.

This changes only these settings screens. It does nothing to the keyboard. When Reduce motion is on, these transitions are already off.

title: Keyboard test button
name: accessibility_keyboard_preview_title
description: A small button on every settings screen that opens the keyboard with a field to type in
help:
The button sits in the bottom corner of every settings screen. Tap it and a text field opens above the real keyboard, so you can try a change on the screen where you made it, without going back to another app. Tap the button again, or hide the keyboard, to close the field. It stays open while you move between settings screens.

Screens that already show a keyboard of their own, such as the theme editor, don't show the button. Turn this off if you don't want the button on your screens.

title: Favourites button
name: favourites_button_title
description: A star at the top of every settings screen that lists your favourite settings
help:
Tap the star at the top of any settings screen to see your favourites, and tap one to go there. In the list, Add this screen pins the screen you are on. To pin one setting, touch and hold it and choose Add to favourites.

The star is filled on a screen that is already a favourite. Turn this off if you don't want the button. Your favourites are kept and come back when you turn it on again.

title: Chat button on every screen
name: toolai_hub_chat_button_everywhere_title
description: Show the button that opens the AI chat on every settings screen, not only this one

title: Offer the Settings assistant
name: toolai_hub_settings_assistant_title
description: Off hides it from search and the AI screens, and it sends nothing

title: Memory
name: toolai_memory_screen_title
description: What the AI remembers about you, kept on this phone

title: Remember things about me
name: toolai_memory_enabled_title
description: Chats save short facts about you, and later chats and AI actions use them
help: The AI saves a fact when you tell it something that will still be true later, or when you ask it to remember something. Each save shows under the answer with Undo. The facts stay on this phone. Incognito fields and private chats never read or save memory, and facts that look like passwords, codes, card numbers or keys are refused. Turning this off stops reading and saving. The saved facts stay until you delete them.

title: Use with cloud models
name: toolai_memory_cloud_title
description: Send the saved facts with requests to the AI service in use, and let its chats save new ones
help: Off, only a model on this phone reads or saves memory. On, the facts picked for a request travel with it to the service you use, and that service's own privacy terms apply to them.

title: Delete all memories
name: toolai_memory_delete_all_title
description: Removes every saved fact from this phone

title: Search by meaning
name: semantic_mode_title
description: Also find things by what they mean, not only by the letters typed
help: Text finds clips, notes, snippets and emoji by meaning. Text and pictures also finds your own stickers and saved GIFs by what they show, and is a larger download. Off keeps search as it was and downloads nothing.

title: Tag my stickers
name: semantic_tag_stickers_title
description: Stickers without keywords get some from what they show, so they come up while you type

title: Delete the model
name: semantic_delete_title
description: Search by meaning

title: TalkBack support
name: accessibility_talkback_title
description: How the keyboard announces the keys
help:
Off: the keys have no spoken name. A screen reader cannot find the keyboard.

Labels: every key has a spoken name. Punctuation keys also have a name, for example "full stop" and "at sign". You type by direct touch as usual. Use this if you start a screen reader only sometimes, or if you use switch access.

Explore by touch: this is the standard keyboard behaviour with a screen reader. Move your finger to hear each key, then activate the key to type it. This changes the keys only while TalkBack runs. When TalkBack is off, the keyboard types as usual.

Gestures: the keyboard keeps its own touch handling while TalkBack runs. The spacebar cursor slide, the backspace word swipe, glide typing and handwriting continue to work. Each key speaks when you touch it, and types when you lift your finger. This mode needs the keyboard gestures service below. Without that service this mode acts like Explore by touch.

title: Ignore repeated presses
name: accessibility_debounce_title
description: Off. The keyboard accepts every press
help:
This setting is for hand tremor or spasticity. After a key registers, the keyboard discards a second press of that key inside this time. One press that you want does not become two characters.

The keyboard filters repeats of the same key only. You can always type two different keys quickly.

Increase the time until the double letters stop. If the time is too long, the keyboard also discards double letters that you want, for example "ll" and "ee".

title: Press and hold delay
name: accessibility_long_press_title
description: How long you hold a key before its alternate keys open

title: Key size and spacing
name: accessibility_key_size_title
description: Taller keys and wider gaps are easier to press accurately

title: Haptics and sound
name: accessibility_haptics_title
description: Confirm each key press with vibration or with sound

title: Version
name: about_version_title
description: %1$s build (%2$s%3$s) · code %4$d

title: Short app name
name: about_launcher_name_title
description: Show "WMK" under the app icon, not "WM Keyboard"
help: This changes only the name under the icon, in your app drawer and on your home screen. Everywhere else, such as the Android app settings, the keyboard list and the app stores, the app keeps its full name. If you opened the app from its icon, this screen opens again when you change the name. Your launcher can take a few seconds to show the new name. If the icon goes from your home screen, add it again from the app drawer.

title: Show in app drawer
name: about_launcher_shown_title
description: The app icon in your app drawer and on your home screen
help: Turn this off to take the icon away. The keyboard keeps working, and these settings are still a tap away: the settings key on the keyboard, the keyboard's entry in Android's keyboard settings, or a settings link. The long-press shortcuts on the icon go with it. On Android 10 and newer, Android may put an icon back that opens the App info page instead, because it does that for every installed app with no icon of its own. Only apps that came with the phone escape it. To stop it for every app, run adb shell settings put global show_hidden_icon_apps_enabled 0 from a computer.

title: App language
name: about_app_language_title
description: The language of the menus and settings. Your typing languages are in Settings, then Languages
help: On Android 13 and newer, this is the same setting as the app language in the Android app settings. When you change one, the other changes too. On Android 12 and older, only the settings app changes. The keyboard stays in the language of your phone.

title: Privacy policy
name: about_privacy_policy_title
description: What leaves your device, and what never leaves it

title: Setting links
name: about_setting_links_title
description: Copy a web link that opens one setting
help: Use this to send someone to a setting. The copy has the path to the setting on its first line, so it can be found by hand too, and the link under it. The link opens this app on that screen and flashes the setting. If the app is not installed, the link opens a page on the website that tells how to get it. "Hold" copies the link when you touch and hold a setting or a group heading. While the favourites button is on, the hold opens a menu with Copy link in it. "Button" shows a small link button next to each setting and group heading. Settings with no fixed name, such as one language or one theme, have no link.

title: Report a bug
name: about_report_bug_title
description: Open an issue on GitHub. Issues are public, easy to search and easy to track

title: Join the Telegram group
name: about_telegram_title
description: Ask questions, share layouts and themes, and hear about new releases first

title: Follow WM Keyboard
name: about_follow_title
description: Tips, new features and short videos

title: How many settings to show
name: settings_depth_title
description: Simple, Standard or Everything
help: Simple shows the basics, like other keyboards. Standard adds the common extras. Everything shows every setting. A setting that is not shown keeps its value, and search still finds it.

title: Show where settings are hidden
name: settings_hidden_rows_title
description: A row at the end of each group that opens what the depth left out

title: Diagnostics
name: about_diagnostics_title
description: A record of what the keyboard did. Read it, or send it with a bug report

title: Run setup again
name: about_replay_onboarding_title
description: Walk through the first-run choices again. Your settings stay as they are

title: Share diagnostics
name: shell_debug_log_share_title
description: Send the report to an email, an issue tracker or a notes app

title: Copy to clipboard
name: shell_debug_log_copy_title
description: The same report, as text

title: Include the system log
name: shell_debug_log_system_title
description: Add the Android log of this app to the report
help: The keyboard writes the app log above. It holds only what the keyboard chose to record. The system log is everything this app printed, including its libraries. It helps more with a problem that is difficult to repeat. The keyboard does not control what goes into it. Read the system log before you send it to anyone.

title: Test the crash screen
name: shell_debug_log_crash_test_title
description: The app crashes on purpose so you can check that the report opens

title: Dictionaries
name: about_dictionaries_title
description: The seed bigrams, the loanword map and the offensive word list are made by hand for this project, and they use its licence. The word lists you download keep the licences of their sources. The Open-source licences screen gives the full list.

title: Check for updates
name: update_row_check_title
description: Ask if a newer version is out

title: Check for updates automatically
name: update_row_auto_check_title
description: Look for a new version when you open this app. Off, nothing is sent until you press Check for updates

title: Ask me about updates
name: update_row_prompts_title
description: Offer a new version when you open this app

title: Include pre-releases
name: update_row_prereleases_title
description: Offer test versions before they are finished

title: Colorful tool icons
name: tools_colored_icons_title
description: Each tool gets its own accent color here and in the toolbox. Open a tool to change the color of that one icon.

title: Gradient tool colors
name: tools_gradient_icons_title
description: Paint each tool with two colors, from the top left to the bottom right
help: Off, a tool is one flat color. On, every tool becomes a gradient that runs from its color at the top left to a second color at the bottom right. The second color is worked out from the first, so you need not pick one. To choose both, open the tool and set the start color and the end color.

title: Split the Panels group
name: tools_split_panels_title
description: Show Writing and Connect and media as two groups

title: Use this mode
name: modes_use_title
description: Off, the mode never turns on and the Modes tool does not show it
help: Turn this off to stop a mode without deleting it. Its apps, field types, hints and overrides are kept, and the mode comes back as it was when you turn it on again.

title: Name
name: modes_name_label
description: The Modes tool shows this name

title: Icon
name: modes_icon_title
description: The Modes tool shows this icon beside the name

title: Emoji row
name: modes_emoji_row_title
description: While this mode is active

title: Autocorrect
name: modes_autocorrect_title
description: While this mode is active

title: Layout
name: modes_layout_title
description: Which layout this mode types on
help: The mode wears this layout while it is on, whichever layout you were using before. Your own layout comes back when the mode ends, and the spacebar swipe order is not changed. Only layouts you have switched on are offered here; if you later switch one off, a mode that used it goes back to inheriting.

title: Theme
name: modes_theme_title
description: Inherit the theme that is set

title: Custom pinned tools
name: modes_pinned_tools_title
description: Change the pinned tools of the toolbar while this mode is active

title: Pinned tools behaviour
name: modes_pinned_behaviour_title
description: The keyboard adds these tools after the tools you pinned yourself

title: Custom toolbox order
name: modes_toolbox_order_title
description: Move the tools of this mode to the front of the toolbox panel

title: Custom symbol sets
name: modes_symbol_sets_title
description: The symbol row shows only the sets of this mode while it is active

title: Automatic spaces
name: modes_autospace_title
description: Spaces the keyboard types for you while this mode is active
help: One switch over every space the keyboard puts in without a press: after punctuation, after a suggestion you pick from the strip, and after a word you glide. Off means every space in the field is one you typed, which is what you want when you are renaming a file extension, typing a command, or filling any field where a stray space is a mistake. On turns all three on, including the space after punctuation, which is off by default everywhere else.

title: Glide typing
name: modes_glide_title
help: Off makes every tap type exactly its key: a tap that drifts across the keys can no longer start a swipe. With autocorrect, suggestions and automatic spaces off too, this is a peck mode for codes, handles, slang and anything else the keyboard would try to fix.

title: Two-thumb typing
name: modes_two_thumb_title
help: Off types each swipe as a word of its own, and a pause no longer ends a tapped word with a space you did not press. A word you are in the middle of is typed as it stands when the mode turns this off.
